summary: The statement and proof are correct. Compactness makes the lattice set finite, the maximum over positive levels reduces exactly to the finite set of positive lattice values, the parity-class midpoint map is lattice-valued and injective, concavity gives the claimed superlevel injection, and the finite layer-cake calculation yields W_epsilon <= 2M with all endpoint and d >= 1 cases valid. Combining this with the heaviest parity class gives M >= 2^(-n-1) W.
